Complete Aegisub Web source and build scripts:
https://github.com/samgum/aegisub-web
The pinned module versions and integrity hashes are in package-lock.json.
To replace or modify a decoder/parser, change its source/dependency in a local
checkout, run npm install and npm run build:demo, then serve demo-dist/.
This application imposes no additional restrictions on modifying or debugging
these libraries. The app code outside those libraries retains its own notices.
